name: print-social-mass-media-infographic-orange-skyline-history-chart
title: 'Mass Media Infographic' with an orange city-skyline header and a history-of-media bar chart
whatItIs: A white infographic with a bold orange skyline header reading 'Mass Media Infographic', percentage stats (19%, 22%, 27%, 32%) beside flat icons (radio, TV, phone, globe), a bar chart titled 'History of Mass Media' comparing paper, TV/radio and internet from 1900-2015, and icon rows for SMS, News, Cinema, Social Media with two hands holding phones.
whatItMeans: Historical and structured; combining a timeline chart with modern icons shows media evolution in one connected story.
techniques: Use a skyline silhouette as a thematic header graphic.
Pair a historical bar chart with modern channel icons.
Show hands holding devices to ground abstract stats in real use.

vocabulary.definition: A city silhouette used as a decorative banner element.
A chart comparing multiple categories over time.
